# Introduction [#](https://docs.nvidia.com/vss/latest/#introduction)
## Why VSS? [#](https://docs.nvidia.com/vss/latest/#why-vss)
1. **GPU-accelerated real-time video pipeline.** VSS uses the NVIDIA DeepStream SDK with TensorRT/Triton-accelerated models and streaming batched inference to process many concurrent camera streams on a single GPU. Throughput scales with available GPU resources rather than per-request API quotas, and capabilities such as synchronized multi-camera 3D detection and tracking with [Sparse4D](https://docs.nvidia.com/vss/latest/models/sparse4d.html) are not exposed by cloud-only vision APIs. See [Performance](https://docs.nvidia.com/vss/latest/performance.html) for measured throughput per GPU.
